theorem QOU.QuantumGeometry.ContactFormAlgebra.degenerate_not_nondegenerate (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (F : Type v) [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] [Nontrivial F] :
¬∀ (x y : F), (∀ (z : F), ((degenerate R F).inner z) x = ((degenerate R F).inner z) y) → x = y

theorem QOU.QuantumGeometry.ContactFormAlgebra.degenerate_adjoint_not_unique (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (F : Type v) [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] [Nontrivial F] :
¬∀ (L : F → F), ∃! Lstar : F → F, ∀ (α β : F), ((degenerate R F).inner (L α)) β = ((degenerate R F).inner α) (Lstar β)

theorem QOU.QuantumGeometry.ContactFormAlgebra.not_hasAdjoint_of_not_additive {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {F : Type v} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] (A : ContactFormAlgebra R F) (L : F → F) (α₁ α₂ β : F) (hne : (A.inner (L (α₁ + α₂))) β ≠ (A.inner (L α₁)) β + (A.inner (L α₂)) β) :

theorem QOU.QuantumGeometry.q_codifferential_formula {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {F : Type v} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] (A : ContactFormAlgebra R F) (q : Rˣ) :
∃ (δ_q : F →ₗ[R] F), (∀ (α β : F), (A.inner ((A.dq q) α)) β = (A.inner α) (δ_q β)) ∧ ∀ (β : F), δ_q β = ↑q⁻¹ • A.δ β + (1 - ↑q⁻¹) • A.lieReebStar (A.iotaReeb β)

theorem QOU.QuantumGeometry.q_codifferential_exists {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {F : Type v} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] (A : ContactFormAlgebra R F) (q : Rˣ) :
∃ (δ_q : F →ₗ[R] F), ∀ (α β : F), (A.inner ((A.dq q) α)) β = (A.inner α) (δ_q β)
